tests.skippedReason: a check for unfinished sections, which no longer applies because every section is built

axe.summary: An automated accessibility audit (axe, against WCAG 2.x levels A and AA) opened 57 pages: every public page in the sitemap, the sign-in and account screens, the dashboard screens and the community chat, signed in as an editor, an administrator and a member. Each page was checked on a phone (360 px) and a desktop (1366 px), in the light and the dark appearance. 1,022 checks ran and none failed.
rows: Automatic WCAG A and AA rules (axe)
Every control reachable and visible with the keyboard
Content shown in full when the device asks for reduced motion
Pages load correctly (including the designed "not found" page)

lighthouse.summary: Google Lighthouse, in its mobile setting (a mid-range phone on a slowed connection), scored the four main pages. The target was 90 or more in every column.

smoke.summary: The whole-site check opened 32 pages (every public page plus the dashboard, the account page and the chat) at phone, tablet and desktop widths (360, 768 and 1440 px) in both appearances. 1,350 checks ran and none failed.
rows: No error messages in the browser
Every image, style and script loads

notes: The only warnings were the 15 sample DOI links on the Publications page, which point to placeholder addresses and will be replaced by the real ones.
Lighthouse suggests longer browser caching for images and styles; this is set on the live server, not in the site itself.
